about: Indi Gupte's work and his agents' work on web-summit.sgit.ai, round 1b. Each shot was checked: no photograph of a person, and no person's name other than Indi Gupte or Dinis Cruz (checked by a text scan of the clipped area and by looking at each image).

items.title: The business cards we are printing: three, one per audience
items.what: Three RiskMandate cards for Web Summit Lisbon, colour-coded for Executives (gold), GRC (green) and Security (blue), with no names; every QR goes to the team page.
items.date: 4 November 2026 (brief); Design A chosen by Dinis Cruz on 5 November

items.title: The business cards, earlier rounds: B Seal, six round-2 designs, round 3
items.what: Round 1 'B Seal', chosen by Indi on 4 November; six round-2 designs (Seal, Pass, Record, Boardroom, Terminal, Signature) for Web Summit; round 3 (Record for everyone, Terminal for engineers) after the user tests.

items.title: Business cards, the brief and the examples
items.what: The brief for the cards and every current example with its print files, in one place for a person or an agent to review. 'The cards: three, one per audience, no names (Indi, 4 November).'

items.title: Synthetic users for the business cards (WS-142)
items.what: Five invented people get a card, scan it and say what they make of it; Claude sub-agents play the personas; the runs go into vaults published on the site. 'Everybody in it is invented; it is not user research.'

items.title: Laptop stickers, the brief and the examples
items.what: Four RiskMandate laptop stickers (one corporate, two infographics, one cartoon), revised after Indi's notes on 4 November evening; each checked by a script for margins, text size and contrast.

items.title: The RiskMandate card, on your phone
items.what: The team's digital business card, for when the printed cards are not to hand; 'Add it to Apple Wallet in one tap'.
items.agent: not stated on the pages read

items.title: Safe AI for learning: RiskMandate for education and children
items.what: 'An idea, not yet built: AI helpers for schools that help students learn and keep children safe online, held to plain-language rules that schools and governments set.' From Indi's brief of 4 November.
items.agent: education@web-summit.indi (page); the brief is Indi's own

items.title: The factory: one infographic per company (WS-27)
items.what: 'What each target company does, the risks it faces from AI agents and how RiskMandate helps, in pictures and in normal and lay terms.'
items.agent: dev@web-summit.indi built it; factory@web-summit.indi makes the pages; a person reviews each

items.title: A factory company page: a target company
items.what: One company in three pictures (what it does, its risks from AI agents, how RiskMandate helps), each in normal terms and in lay terms; sources read 1 November 2026.

items.title: How an interview reaches PrompTugal.news
items.what: 'The newsroom workflow as an infographic: from a handshake at Web Summit to a published interview, who does each step, the hand-overs, and what stays private.' Tested on a stranger (a sub-agent) before publishing.
items.agent: conductor-newsroom@web-summit.indi (a one-off helper started by conductor@web-summit.indi)
items.date: 10 November 2026: brief about 12:40 UTC, live at 15:00 (v0.2.1706)

items.title: Indi's agents: who wakes when
items.what: 'Indi's agents as one picture: 5 on a timetable with 10 wake-ups a day, one planned, and 9 that work when asked. A timeline and a mind map for each.'

items.title: Token efficiency: the team's agents
items.what: '264 measured wakes from 37 agents cost 180.5M tokens, 65% of it cache reads. The same output could cost 24% to 53% less. Ten rules, ready for an ABP.' Written at Indi's word, using the accountant's method.
items.agent: accountant@web-summit.indi's method; the page does not name its writer

items.title: The accountant's daily token report and the token guide
items.what: 'What your agents cost today, how to spend less, and the decisions it needs from you. New every day at 5:30 pm'; and 'One picture: how to get better answers for fewer tokens.' Files not opened.

items.title: Indi: everything left to do
items.what: 'Indi's open tasks as one picture: 64 Command Centre tasks by when they are due, 7 decisions, and 25 other tasks, rebuilt at every release.'

items.title: Indi's day
items.what: 'Indi's day on one page in plain words', with what each agent is doing.

items.title: Indi Gupte's command centre
items.what: 'tasks from the board, agents, workstreams and decisions, built from the repository.' Not captured: its main view shows other people's names.
items.agent: built by the site at every release

items.title: Indi's dashboard
items.what: 'The page Indi reads first', with his 27 agents, the 'who they write to' chart and links to all his pages.
items.agent: dashboard@web-summit.indi (the part below the built block)

items.title: RiskMandate LinkedIn post drafts
items.what: 'drafts one post a day for RiskMandate's LinkedIn page (company voice, plus a reshare line in Indi's voice), with a picture suggestion and dated sources'; 'Friday's LinkedIn post, thank you, Lisbon, is drafted.' No public page of the drafts was found.

items.title: The venue map in the PrompTugal Team app
items.what: 'the venue map screen in the PrompTugal Team app (Apple Maps with our own venue drawing, option B of people/indi/wayfinding/05-venue-map.md) and venue.geojson.' people/indi/wayfinding/ is not published (404).

items.title: The Team app redesign (overnight helper)
items.what: 'the Team app's light mode, ticked-off tasks with an animation, a bigger venue-map button and place details in Where, every Web Summit event in Plan with location and category pills, no app-switcher cover, and one-tap messaging.' Listed as proposed, not yet running; no public page found.

items.title: The public PrompTugal app redesign
items.what: 'the UI and UX redesign of the public PrompTugal app (news.promptugal.reader): fewest taps per workflow, the Team app redesign's lessons, original colours, no AI-sounding text.' No public page found.

items.title: Three apps, three lines
items.what: 'The product strategy for our apps, at Dinis's word (8 November 2026, with Indi).' Kept by Dinis Cruz's conductor, not by Indi's agents.
